name: scene-1
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the supplied picnic illustration as ONE preschool coloring sheet, portrait 1024 x 1536. Keep the faithful action: small PinPin hedgehog offers ONE large whole apple with both paws to seated larger Papa hedgehog, who receives it with one paw; their friendly faces look at each other. Scooby, the floppy-eared dog with a curled tail, rests behind Papa and watches. Recompose vertically without cropping any character: Papa upper-right, child lower-left, dog above/right, apple centered between paws. Preserve species, adult/child size difference, recognizable faces and correct separate paws. Simple picnic blanket under them with one loaf and one cup; omit all other background except two very simple tree trunks. For a FOUR-YEAR-OLD coloring with thick crayons: bold smooth uniform pure BLACK outlines on pure WHITE background, very large closed white fillable areas. Simplify quills into zigzag silhouettes with at most six large inner quill shapes, dog smooth white coat with no fur strokes. No tiny details, grass blades, flower fields, texture, hatching, shadows, gray, shading, gradients, solid dark coat, color, text or letters. Friendly outlined eyes with tiny black pupils are allowed; all major shapes remain white inside. Generous print margins; one complete scene, no panels.

review.notes: Transparent paper and fill regions; not an opaque white printable sheet.
